verdict.rationale: The Terms of Service document a first-party opt-out from AI model training on user Materials via app.instinct.com/settings, and Vault contents are never used for training. Community screenshots of an earlier perpetual-license ToS show concern, not a demonstrated failure of the opt-out, so the claim is not disputed. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that conversations count as "Materials" covered by the opt-out, detail on the default (training appears on unless you opt out), and any hands-on or independent verification that the setting works.
